data.title: Spanish village holds memorial mass for train crash victims
data.description: URDA (SPAIN) - Residents and local officials gathered on Saturday in a Spanish village near the site of a high-speed train collision that killed at least 69 people for a memorial Mass honouring the victims.

data.title: Rubio flags challenges in finding consensus as G20 talks wrap
data.description: ATLANTA - The United States on Saturday urged against using food trade as a tool for "economic or political coercion," while acknowledging the difficulty of reaching a G20 consensus as foreign ministers wrapped talks.

data.title: 'Trump betrayed us': Arizona's Latino voters sour on president
data.description: YUMA (UNITED STATES) - Two years ago, Fernando Nunez went door-to-door in searing heat to help Donald Trump win Arizona and take back the White House.

data.title: Israeli protesters demand opposition ally with Arab parties to oust Netanyahu
data.description: TEL AVIV - Hundreds of Israelis took to the streets on Saturday to urge the opposition to ally with Arab parties to oust Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who has gone on the offensive against the minority group's leaders.

data.title: Scam centres relocated from Cambodia operate in Madagascar
data.description: ANTANANARIVO (MADAGASCAR) - Raids against online scam centres in Madagascar have exposed ties with a criminal group that ran similar operations in Cambodia, also duping African nationals via alleged human trafficking, authorities told AFP.

data.title: German police, protesters clash after 'Gen Z' demos
data.description: FRANKFURT (GERMANY) - German police and protesters clashed across the country Saturday following massive youth-led protests, with authorities using water cannon and pepper spray as masked demonstrators hurled fireworks, stones and bottles.

data.title: Brighton stun Man City, 10-man Man Utd beaten by Chelsea
data.description: MANCHESTER (UNITED KINGDOM) - Brighton inflicted a second straight Premier League defeat on Manchester City with a 1-0 win to close within two points of the leaders on Saturday, while Manchester United slumped to another damaging defeat for Michael Carrick at Chelsea.

data.title: Russia says responding to US report of planned attack on Moscow
data.description: MOSCOW - Russia's FSB security service said on Saturday it was carrying out "appropriate" measures after the US embassy in Moscow warned of a planned "terrorist" attack in the capital.

data.title: China state TV does not air first La Liga games since Mbappe furore
data.description: BEIJING - Chinese state television did not air on Saturday the first La Liga games since Real Madrid star Kylian Mbappe caused anger with a joke about the country's former leader Mao Zedong.

data.title: Germans join Europe's wave of 'Gen Z' protests
data.description: FRANKFURT (GERMANY) - Thousands of young Germans took to the streets nationwide Saturday in the latest protests in Europe led by youths angry at political elites they say are ignoring their concerns.

data.title: Forced to eat grass, Oleshky evacuees say truce was a 'blessing'
data.description: CHERNIGIV REGION (UKRAINE) - Evacuees from Oleshky, a bombed-out city in Russian-occupied Ukraine, told AFP that residents had to eat grass and dogs to survive and that their rescue following a humanitarian truce was a "blessing".

data.description: Residents of the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky, bombed and ravaged by years of war, were expected to arrive in Ukraine on Saturday after being evacuated during a rare truce brokered by US First Lady Melania Trump.

data.description: Thai entrepreneurs operating in China’s southern island province of Hainan say the opportunities created by the island’s growing free-trade economy remain significant, but success depends heavily on mastering the Chinese language, building local networks and understanding regulatory requirements.

data.title: British PM ‘open’ to slavery apology, rules out reparations
data.description: LONDON - British ⁠Prime ⁠Minister Andy Burnham has said ​he is open to calls for a formal apology for Britain’s ​historical role in slavery, before ‌attending next week’s Commonwealth summit at which he is likely to face demands for financial reparations.

data.title: ‘Nightlife sandbox’ to enforce laws on Khao San
data.description: The government plans to introduce a sandbox scheme covering Khao San and Rambuttri roads in Bangkok to improve law enforcement at entertainment venues and prevent corruption among state officials.

data.title: Rangers win praise for ‘heavy tortoise mission’ in forest
data.description: Wildlife rangers at Si Phang Nga National Park have won public praise for taking turns carrying a 20-kilogramme Asian forest tortoise back into the forest after it wandered towards a nearby community.

data.title: Vietnamese women arrested for prostitution on Sukhumvit Rd
data.description: Authorities have arrested seven Vietnamese women on charges of soliciting prostitution in the Sukhumvit area of Bangkok and are preparing to deport them.

data.title: ‘Zombie pods’ seized ahead of Halloween night
data.description: More than 3,000 electronic cigarettes and “zombie pods” worth nearly 3 million baht have been seized in the Northeast in a crackdown on smuggled products ahead of Halloween celebrations.
